# IntelliFusion (Codebase Intelligence Platform) - runtime dependencies.
#
# Install into the project's virtual environment with:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Generated by scanning every top-level import actually used across
# app/, api/, cli.py, server.py, session_store.py, insight.py, jobs.py,
# tests/, and the legacy ui/ + ui_pages/ + app_ui.py (kept installable
# alongside the current FastAPI app - see their module-level deprecation
# notices for why they're still here).
#
# Playwright additionally needs its browser binary after installing the
# Python package:
#   playwright install chromium

# --- Web server (current UI: server.py + webapp/) ---
fastapi==0.141.1
uvicorn==0.51.0
python-multipart==0.0.32
pydantic==2.13.4

# --- Legacy UI (app_ui.py, ui/, ui_pages/ - deprecated, see their headers) ---
streamlit==1.60.0

# --- RAG pipeline: embeddings, vector store, retrieval ---
chromadb==1.5.9
sentence-transformers==5.6.1
rank-bm25==0.2.2
networkx==3.6.1
numpy==2.5.1
tiktoken==0.13.0

# --- Ingestion: document/website/GitHub loaders ---
requests==2.34.2
beautifulsoup4==4.15.0
pdfplumber==0.11.10
python-docx==1.2.0
fpdf2==2.8.7
playwright==1.61.0
pillow==12.3.0

# --- OCR (image text extraction) ---
easyocr==1.7.2

# --- Audio/Video ingestion: local transcription + frame extraction ---
# Both bundle their own codec libs in the pip wheel (PyAV for
# faster-whisper, OpenCV's own build for opencv-python-headless), so
# unlike Playwright above, neither needs a separate system install for
# standard mp3/wav/mp4/m4a files - verified live against real files on
# a machine with no system ffmpeg on PATH. See app/ingestion/loader.py
# for the caveat this doesn't cover every possible codec.
faster-whisper==1.2.1
opencv-python-headless==5.0.0.93

# --- Native acoustic similarity search (app/embeddings/audio_embedder.py) ---
# transformers is already an implicit transitive dependency of
# sentence-transformers below (which is what actually resolves it at
# install time) - pinned explicitly here anyway because CLAP's exact
# call shape is version-sensitive (this codebase already hit two real
# API differences: ClapProcessor's audio kwarg name, and
# get_audio_features()/get_text_features() returning a
# BaseModelOutputWithPooling needing .pooler_output). An explicit pin
# makes a future incompatible transformers version a loud, obvious
# install-time mismatch instead of a silent CLAP behavior change.
transformers==5.14.1

# --- Session/pending-tracker file locking ---
filelock==3.32.0

# --- Tests ---
pytest==9.1.1
